seoTitle: How to Use Gemini AI with Google Workspace (2026)
metaDescription: See how to integrate Gemini AI's 2.5 Pro and Veo 3 video features into Google Workspace to speed up everyday tasks across Docs, Sheets, and Gmail.
intro: Gemini AI is now built into Google Workspace, giving you AI assistance without leaving Docs, Sheets, or Gmail. This guide covers how to set up Gemini and start using its 2.5 Pro and Veo 3 video capabilities to support your daily workflow.

steps.heading: Understand what Gemini AI offers
steps.body: Gemini AI brings generative writing, summarization, and now video generation through Veo 3 directly into the Workspace apps you already use.

steps.heading: Set up Gemini in your Workspace account
steps.body: Depending on your plan, Gemini may need to be enabled by an admin or added as an add-on before it appears inside your apps.

steps.heading: Explore the 2.5 Pro features
steps.body: The 2.5 Pro model handles more complex requests — like drafting longer documents or analyzing data in Sheets — with improved accuracy over earlier versions.

steps.heading: Try Veo 3 for video generation
steps.body: Veo 3 lets you generate short video content from text prompts, which can be useful for presentations, marketing material, or internal communications.

steps.heading: Combine Gemini with your existing Workspace tools
steps.body: Use Gemini alongside Docs, Sheets, and Gmail to draft content, summarize threads, and speed up repetitive tasks without switching apps.

faq.question: Is Gemini AI included in all Google Workspace plans?
faq.answer: Availability depends on your specific Workspace edition — some plans include Gemini by default while others require it as an add-on.

faq.question: What's the difference between Gemini 2.5 Pro and earlier versions?
faq.answer: 2.5 Pro is built to handle more complex, multi-step requests with greater accuracy compared to earlier Gemini models.

faq.question: Can I use Veo 3 to create videos directly inside Workspace apps?
faq.answer: Veo 3's video generation is accessed through Gemini's interface within Workspace, letting you create short clips from text prompts.

faq.question: Do I need any special training to use Gemini in Workspace?
faq.answer: No special training is required — Gemini is designed to work through natural prompts inside the apps you already use daily.
